//ConnectionStrings: Not stored here. Set ConnectionStrings__DefaultConnection as an environment variable (or user-secret in Development).

Jwt.//SigningKey: Set Jwt__SigningKey (min. 32 characters) as an environment variable or user-secret.

Cors.//: Frontend origins allowed to call the API with credentials. Use the HTTPS site origin in production.

Seed.//Passwords: Set Seed__AdminPassword and Seed__CustomerPassword via environment variables or user-secrets. Accounts are skipped when unset.
